text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having not seen Hatsune since she last lost control of her superpowers,
{0} becomes worried and decides to pay her a visit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
超能力の暴走以来見かけなくなったハツネを心配して
彼女の元を訪ねる{0}──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Just a minute! Who is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
どちらさまですか～？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wah!
Why are you here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
うわ！
どうして！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 'Cause you got worried?
Oh, right... Sorry, I guess I'm still being a nuisance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
心配だったから？
そっか……
ごめんね、
また
迷惑かけちゃったね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
My superpowers have been acting up since back then...
So I decided to just stay at home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれからずっと
超能力の調子がおかしくて……
だから
ずっとおうちにいたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if my superpowers go crazy again when we're in town,
I'm pretty sure someone's gonna notice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
街でまた暴走しちゃったら、
今度こそ
誰かに見つかっちゃうかもだし……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, whenever I'm in Landosol I just end up causing trouble for
everyone, so I'm just gonna be a shut-in for the rest of my life...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう～、
ランドソルにいたら、
みんなを困らせちゃうし、
このまま引きこもって生きるよ～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Not a clue!
Why is this happening to me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんにもないよ～
どうしてこんなことになっちゃったんだろう……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hey, from your point of view, have you noticed anything at all unusual?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ。
逆に{0}くんから見て、
何か気付いたことってあったりするのかな？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hiccupping?
Huhhh? Maybe...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃっくり？
ええー？　
そうかな？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Now that you mention it, I guess these days I do hiccup
each time my superpowers manifest...
choice_data_list: What does Shiori say about it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
でも確かに、
この前は超能力が出るたびに、
しゃっくりしてたかも……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she can't get involved!
If something happened to her, I'd never forgive myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それはダメ！
シオリンを巻き込んで
何かあったら大変だもん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, even just talking to you like this might end up causing you
trouble. So it's best if you just go home already...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当は
こうして{0}くんと話してても、
迷惑かけちゃうかもしれないんだよ？
だからもう
今日は帰った方がいいよ～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Argh! If something bad happens, don't say I didn't warn you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
何かあってからじゃ
遅いんだからね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But... thanks...
You saying that makes me feel kinda relieved—
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
ありがと……
そう言ってくれて、
なんだかほっとしちゃった──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*hic*
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく！
スヤァ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
H-huh...?
Waaah, I did it again...
I'm so sorry, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ……？
うわ～、
またやっちゃった……
ごめんね、{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Changing the subject, where the heck are we?
Er... l-let's ask that person over there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはそうと、
ここって
どこだろ？
え～と……
あ、
あっちに人が……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoaaa! That's no person, it's a monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
うわわわ！　
人じゃなくて魔物だよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}! Are you all right?!
Why, you little...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！　
大丈夫！？
このぉ～！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUAAUUGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}, are you all─
Wh-whoaaa! What's with this light?!
A-ahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
ケガは──
って、
わわわわわ！　
なんか光っちゃってるよ！？
え、
ええええ～～～！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's {0}.
...Heeey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、{0}くんだ。
……おーい！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, fancy meeting you here!
You heading somewhere?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなところで会うなんて
奇遇だね！
どこかお出かけ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I've got nothing to do, so I'm just taking a walk.
It's good to give your legs a stretch every once in a while, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はヒマだから
お散歩だよ～
たまにはこうやって
自分の足で歩いとかないとね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go, let's go!
Well, no idea where to though!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
行く行く～！
って
どこに行くか分かんないけど！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'll go anywhere, as long as it's with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんとだったら
どこへでもついてっちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Well then, I guess we're boredom buddies!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～、
私たちヒマヒマ仲間だね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Then I might as well do you the pleasure of tagging along!
I'll teach you the secrets to the art of killing time! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくだし
初音ちゃんがついていってあげよう！
特別にヒマの潰し方を
教えてあげちゃうぞ☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it sure is peaceful today, huh?
Wait, oh nooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても平和だね～
って、
わわわっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Over there! A kid just ran into the road...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あそこ！　
子供が道路に飛び出して……！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}, look out!
Take that, Truck-kun!

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hmnm...
text_block_list.orig_text: ううん……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? {0}...
Thank goodness, he's still alive...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……{0}くん……
そっか、
無事だったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I managed to rescue him with my superpowers...
Eheheh, that's a relief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと超能力で守れたんだ……
えへへ、
よかったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
This whole time, have I been... sleeping... on his lap?
Oh, I see. He's looking after me 'cause I conked out in the street.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これって、
もしかして、
膝枕……
だよね？
そっか、
私が眠っちゃったから
付き添ってくれてたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But y'know... thinking about it, his face is super close.
Scratch that, his face is waaay too close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
これって……
よく考えたら
顔が近くない？
っていうか近い、
近すぎだよ～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Uuurgh, but I'll headbutt him if I jump to my feet...
Wh-what should I do?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
でも飛び起きたら頭ぶつけちゃうし……
どど、
どうしよ～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait, has he been watching me sleep this whole time...?
Uuurgh, I hope I wasn't drooling or anything...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
もしかしてずっと寝顔見られてた……？
うう、
よだれとか垂れてないよね……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: A-and now it's awkward 'cause I've waited too long to get up...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
恥ずかしいけど
起きるタイミング逃しちゃった……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: *peek*
text_block_list.orig_text: チラッ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ah! I made eye contact...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ、
目が合っちゃった……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Zzz... I-I'm still sleeping, y'know.
In fact, I'm so deeply asleep that I'm in a coma.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むにゃむにゃ……
ね、
寝てますよ～
完璧に寝ちゃってますよ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
And don't forget, Sleeping Beauty won't wake up without a kiss from
her Prince Charming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに眠り姫は、
おはようのキスじゃないと目覚めないのだ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whoa there!
Time-out! Time-out right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？　
ふええええ！？
ちょっとタンマ！　
タンマタンマ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Y-you can't just do that all of a sudden!
Come on! You startled me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いきなりそういうのはダメだよぉ！
も～、
びっくりしたなあ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hnnn... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! You can't poke me like that!
It's against the rules!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃん！　
つっついちゃダメです！
そういうのは反則だよ～～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, haven't you ever heard of tact?
But... eheheh, I'm glad you're okay, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
デリカシーは大切だぞ！
でも……
えへへ、
{0}くんが無事でよかったぁ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm sleepy with relief. Just give me... mmm... five more minutes...
Or maybe thirty... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心したら眠くなっちゃったよ……
ん……
もうちょっとだけ……
この……
まま……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Hello, it's good to have you back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れ様。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter which world you're in, you're always trying to protect
Hatsune. How admirable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どちらの世界でも、
ちゃんとハツネを守ろうとしてたわね。
感心感心。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I know it seems like she's always using you,
but make sure to be there whenever she's in trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもハツネには振り回されてるみたいだけど、
あの子が困ってるならちゃんと助けてあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Well, I trust you two will be just fine.
Anyway, that's about all I've got for you this time.
Bye-bye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
あんたたちなら大丈夫だと信じてるわ。
それじゃあ、
今回はこれくらいにしときましょ。
ばいば～い。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, the monster...!
Oh, guess I killed it... Thank goodness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！！　
あ、
魔物は……！？
倒せてたみたいだね……
よかったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! {0}, are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
{0}くん、大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You're just sleeping.
What a relief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった……
寝てるだけか～
一安心だよ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...That's right.
This time I protected you with my superpowers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そっか。
私、
超能力で{0}くんを守れたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あれ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
They just activated normally. If I remember right, I didn't hiccup at all.
I wonder why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの超能力は、
しゃっくりなしで普通に出た感じだったな～
なんでだろ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Either way, I'm just glad you're not hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
本当によかった……
{0}くんが無事で。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Poke, poke! I'm gonna tease you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うりうり、
ちょっとつっついちゃえ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You really are asleep, huh? Heheh...
We'll save the wake-up kiss... for next time, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく寝てるな～
ふふ……
お目覚めのキスは……
また
今度、
だよ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: So saying, Hatsune prodded {0} on the lips.
text_block_list.orig_text: そう言って、{0}の唇をつつくハツネであった。
